video._exactRaster: true = 2D layers are rasterised on the CPU instead of the GPU (slower, debugging only).

timing._doc: offset>0 makes ALL visuals (lyrics + beat reactions) happen later; lyricOffset shifts lyrics only. keywordSnap: ALL-CAPS lines snap to the nearest beat if within this many seconds (0 = off). Seconds.

palettes._doc: Colour is STATE, not decoration (docs/v4/PLAN.md §2). off = AI not started / user gone (greyscale). on = conversation live. warm = same hue, hotter. error = a UI error has happened. ash = errors dismissed, a little orange left. dead = powered down. errRed / errCream are full-field variants of `error` for single shots; errWarm (v4) is the state of the plates from 162.81 to 192.34 s: the dark ground of `error` with the orange and the cream of `warm` (no hue of its own; red only as thin edges). Roles: bg page, panel darker surface, raised cards/bubbles/inputs, line hairlines, text = cream = YOU and primary UI text, sub / mute secondary and disabled text, me = orange = the AI, meHot / meDim brighter / darker orange, err / errDim red. glow = bloom multiplier, sat = how much colour the character art keeps (0 = greyscale).

spot._doc: RECOLOURED 2026-10-14 for the new heroine (black + silver-white + fog blue). CORRECTION: verse-2 object colours (eggplant, tomato) are ice-cream white now — shapes unchanged, only the fill. The AI's warm orange (me/meHot/meDim/bloom) is fog blue / silver-white across all palettes; warm paper tints cooled; text (cream = the user) kept.

fonts._doc: Type roles: mono = system and code, serif = what the AI says, sans = interface and the user. kr* / tc* only for the counting cards and (tcSans) the Chinese line of the warning page before the song: `text` lists EVERY character a role may draw, only those are preloaded. All SIL OFL 1.1 via @fontsource. Sizes are in virtual 1920x1080 units.

typing._doc: Lyric lines are typed as messages. charsPerSec caps speed; maxFraction caps typing time as a share of the line duration.

glow._doc: Matte interface, local glow. Bloom strength = (base + low * lowGain + flash * flashGain) * palette.glow, and only SATURATED pixels feed it: between satKnee[0] and satKnee[1] saturation a pixel goes from no bloom to full bloom, so cream / grey UI stays flat while orange and red accents glow.

safety._doc: Photosensitivity guard. maxFlash caps every full-screen flash. preroll = seconds of silent warning page BEFORE the song (v4): the film starts at song time -preroll; every time in the code is song time (audio start = 0), so no cue moves. flashRange = the stretch the warning names, in SONG seconds; whatever is shown to viewers (the warning page, README, storyboard) adds preroll to it. warningLine = the Chinese line of the warning page (its characters must also be in fonts.cjk -> tcSans -> text, or they are not loaded). The small warning toast is still shown until warningSeconds of song time. tools/check_flash.py measures an exported file (use a 60 fps export).

reactive._doc: Beat/onset mapping. strongOnset = minimum onset strength (0..1) that may trigger a secondary accent.
